title: Test-form integrability gives integrability of x ↦ v(x)(c) on compact subsets of U
statement: For all P, k ∈ ℕ and every open U ⊆ ℝ^P: let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^P and v : ℝ^P → Λ_k(ℝ^P) (NVector (Eucl P) k, i.e. each v(x) is a continuous linear functional on k-covectors) be such that x ↦ v(x)(ω(x)) is μ-integrable for every test form ω ∈ D^k(U) (TestFormOn U k: smooth of every finite order, compact support, tsupport ω ⊆ U). Then for every compact L ⊆ U and every k-covector c ∈ Λ^k(ℝ^P) (Covector (Eucl P) k), the function x ↦ v(x)(c) is μ-integrable on L.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Integrable (fun x => v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x)) μ) → ∀ L : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → ∀ c : Covector (Eucl P) k, IntegrableOn (fun x => v x c) L μ
